analysis.purpose: The visualization graph builder: converts the stored graph into a plain JSON snapshot for the canvas UI, refining symbols into display kinds and attaching summaries and cluster membership.
responsibilities: Convert the graph into a self-contained JSON snapshot
Refine symbols into derived display kinds
Emit clusters separately with membership attached

businessRules.rule: The snapshot is plain JSON with no live connection to the store.
businessRules.rationale: The viewer must work from a file without running the indexer.

nodes.name: Graph visualization
nodes.summary: JSON snapshot for the canvas UI.

edges.rationale: This file builds the viz graph.

evidence.quote: const SORT_BY_ID = <T extends { id: string }>(a: T, b: T): number => a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
